blocks.x: Energy per site down 18% — telemetry-driven optimization at 12,000 sites

A Middle East operator group — a Telecom, Media & Entertainment engagement delivered by a blended Dataq Software team under the outcome-linked engagement model. Identity withheld as standard; the figures are the client's, reproduced with permission.
Per-site energy uninstrumented; optimization anecdotal; ESG reporting manual.
Site incidents (power, climate, security) found by outage. Commitment strategy unused; cloud spend escalating.

We instrumented site-level energy and environment telemetry, built the optimization models (load-shaping, equipment scheduling, temperature policies), and delivered the ESG data spine with lineage for disclosure. Site incidents now predicted; cloud commitments rightsized with utilization tracking.
The three things that made it hold

items: the platform work made scaling boring, which is the highest compliment infrastructure can earn.
the twin drifted when the asset drifted — and the sync loop caught it, which is what kept operators using it.
lineage and freshness were design constraints from week one, so the measurement never became the controversy.
